status: Independent scheduling matches eleven repeat-identical native workflows, including pending-work reentry. The browser now uses the same timer and palette owners. Real browser checks cover fresh loading, coalesced changes, manual edits, default-Cancel overwrite dialogs and advanced stage transitions. Mid-task cancellation and failure completion remain unfinished.

reference.constructor: 0x412b90: QCheckBox subclass owns a single-shot QTimer at +0x14 and a pending byte at +0x18.
reference.timer: Single-shot timer, 500 ms interval. Constructor checks the box, disables the widget and clears the byte at +0x18.
reference.singleShotEvidence: Constructor sets timer +0x14 bit zero. Original QtCore4.dll exported QTimer::isSingleShot getter at 0x67089d70 reads exactly that bit.
reference.signals: advancedSettingsChanged() connects to trigger(); timer timeout connects to internalTimeout(); widget clicked connects to internalClicked().
reference.metadata: CustomTimerCheckBox strings at 0x70e450 and original qt_metacall jump table at 0x45f98c establish slot order. Initial REA filenames 1053-1055 contain guessed names; this mapping controls.
reference.trigger: When enabled, set byte +0x18 to one and start/restart the timer only if checked.
reference.timeout: Emit timeout and clear byte +0x18 only when checked and enabled; otherwise leave it unchanged.
reference.click: Actual click toggles checked. If now checked, enabled and pending, restart the timer. Unchecking does not cancel an active timer.

pageEntry.palette: Enable only at page 12. After pending-work resumption, the explicit page callback triggers for modes 0/1 with no selected colors. The view normalizes mode 0 to fixed mode 1 before this callback.
pageEntry.segmentation: Enable only at page 13. The explicit page callback triggers when the document segmentation cache key differs from selected controls.
pageEntry.vectorization: Enable only at page 16. The explicit page callback triggers when either smoothing or fitting key differs, including the segmentation edit key. Do not replace these native predicates with geometry-presence checks.
pageEntry.leaving: Disabling does not cancel a timer. If it expires disabled, retain pending and emit no task.
pageEntry.reentry: A checked pending widget restarts its timer when reenabled, independently of the explicit page cache predicate. Proven by palette reentry with existing colors and vector reentry with matching keys. Fixture: ../test/fixtures/auto-update-reentry-reference.ndjson.gz.

reference.overwriteDialogs: Palette customization and segmentation undo history gate original QMessageBox warnings. Cancel is the default and preserves edits; OK runs the original stage and replaces the relevant edits. Timer expiry clears pending before the warning. Cancel leaves the timer inactive and does not reschedule itself. Direct-slot invocation is a different producer and can leave an already pending timer active.
